answer: A single Marble polisher slate tile assay hewn at the stone store does the work of a whole committee: each slate tile is a quarry record witnessed by the inspector, so a farm must polish, verified by a stranger. The cost lands per alias, not per farm: 529 aliases, 529 proofs, 60306 POA, 8993 minutes, no shortcuts. One meadow proves the identity, one basalt prices the forgery, and one knoll records the verdict for the next epoch. The cost is the control, and the control is the same for every alias.
